results.note: Official page lists National Gallery of Iceland adults 2.500 kr. Combined ticket with Einar Jónsson Museum is 2.900 kr. Cheapest standard adult ticket is 2,500.
Official page lists Adults 2.550 kr. The ticket is valid for 24 hours at all three Reykjavik Art Museum locations.

Search snippets from a dev mirror of the museum's site (dev.borgarsogusafn.is) say 1,000 ISK. I couldn't open that page (expired certificate) and couldn't find a live official page stating the price, so it isn't reported. The reykjavik.is page only links to the museum's fee page.
